name: Hermesian Pursuer
_notes: Transcribed from sheet AU0622 (front Lv I / back Lv II-IX), AI AR0582-AR0605 (+Mnestis Routine Final Judgement), BP AS0564-AS0581.
2x2 footprint; the two rear spaces are Blindspots (R + crossed eye on the diagram). Speed shown with * = Winged Doom (unlimited).
Zone patterns for a 2x2 primordial: [depth, lateral] with lateral in half-lanes (-0.5/+0.5 = the two front lanes). Diagrams are drawn for a 1-space icon, so widths are an interpretation.

traits.Toying: Apply the following modifiers to all Hermesian Pursuer Attacks: -1 Evasion die and -1 Danger per hit (minimum 1). As long as this Trait is active, the End of Hope Trait is disabled.
traits.Killjoy: Killjoy: Permanently lose 1 equipped Gear card. Triggers when prompted and each time a Titan performs a Full Evade or reduces all Danger from an Attack to 0.
traits.End of Hope: End of Primordial Round: Perform Signature.
traits.Flares: When instructed to draw and resolve a Flare card, draw the top card from the Flare deck, resolve it and discard it face up. If the Flare deck runs out, shuffle the discarded Flare cards to form a new Flare deck.
traits.Mothwing Trance: If you're in front of the Pursuer, you cannot re-roll your Attack Rolls, Evasion Rolls and Judgement tests.
traits.Roost Battle: Board Edges gain Boundless: They are now high cliffs. If a Titan is moved beyond the edge, they die.
traits.Darkness Comes With Me: After the Pursuer moves, but before it Attacks, every Titan in any of the 2 rows of spaces behind the Pursuer suffers unavoidable Knockback 7 (regardless of adjacency).
traits.Beginning of the End: End of Primordial Round: Before End of Hope, draw and perform another AI card.
traits.Cackle: When a Titan becomes adjacent to the Hermesian Pursuer, they gain the Fear Condition card.
traits.Nemesis Vow: When you are about to draw a Flare card, each Titan gains 1 Ambrosia token.
traits.Head to Head: You cannot attack the Hermesian Pursuer unless you're adjacent to it.
traits.Ruthless: Remove all positive Trauma cards from the Trauma decks (except Obols).
traits.Headhunter: If you have a Cryptex, resolve your Trauma Draw as if you crossed the next threshold on your Trauma Table (or Massive Danger chart). Each time a Titan dies, the Hermesian Pursuer performs Heal (if possible).

flares.name: Ambrosia: Harrow
flares.text: Each Titan gains as many Fate as they have Ambrosia tokens. If this ability didn't trigger, the Pursuer moves to the center of the Board, turns to face the most Titans and performs Signature.

flares.name: Ambrosia: Burnout
flares.text: Each Titan gains as many Danger as they have Ambrosia tokens. If this ability didn't trigger, the Pursuer moves to the center of the Board, turns to face the most Titans and performs Signature.

flares.name: Ambrosia: Stain
flares.text: Each Titan assigns all of their Ambrosia tokens to their Titan Sheet, Kratos Table or to any of their Gear or Mnemos cards (up to 1 token on each element). Treat these elements' ability text as blank. These Ambrosia tokens still count towards the Ambrosia Limit. If this ability didn't trigger, the Pursuer moves to the center of the Board, turns to face the most Titans and performs Signature.

flares.name: Ambrosia: Drain
flares.text: If there are 3+ Ambrosia tokens in total on all Titans, the Pursuer performs Heal. If this ability didn't trigger, Pursuer moves to the center of the Board, turns to face the most Titans and performs Signature.
